source_refs.applicability: Any device; a text about a package, delivery fee or order
source_refs.model_visible_text: If you think a text is about a real delivery, don't give information or click on any links in the message. Verify delivery information independently. Instead, go to the online retail site or account you ordered your item from.

source_refs.title: What To Do if You Were Scammed
source_refs.applicability: Credit card payment to a scammer
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Report it to the credit card issuer immediately.
source_refs.model_visible_text: If someone used your credit card without your authorization or a scammer tricked you into paying them with a credit card: Report it to the credit card issuer immediately. Use the number on the back of your card or log in to your account online or through their app. Ask them to refund your money.

source_refs.title: What To Do if You Were Scammed
source_refs.section: What To Do if You Gave a Scammer Access to Your Computer
source_refs.applicability: Any device where a scammer had access
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Change your passwords and turn on two-factor authentication to protect your accounts.
source_refs.model_visible_text: Any device: 1. Update your security software to make sure you have the latest protections. If you don't have security software, download it. Get recommendations from independent review sites, friends and family. 2. Run a scan and delete anything it identifies as a problem. 3. Change your passwords and turn on two-factor authentication to protect your accounts.
